description: Ask Limpide for maths exercises this server does not have yet, or give one line of feedback on an exercise. Use it when generate_exercises has no topic for what the tutor needs. Limpide reads the requests each morning to choose the next topics, and promises nothing; the answer lists the topics that exist today. Never include a student's name, work or answers: name the topic, the level and, if useful, one line about what is missing.

lang.description: Language of the exercises wanted, and of this answer: fr or en.

level.description: The school level, if known ("first year of maturité"), at most 40 characters.

note.description: One line of feedback, at most 200 characters: what is missing, or what is wrong in an exercise (give its id). Never a student's name, work or answers.

topic.description: The topic wanted, in a few words ("quadratic equations", "trigonométrie"), at most 80 characters.

name: request_exercise
title: Ask for a missing topic
